pages.title: New Hostile Mobs
pages.text: $(mod_name) introduces a greater variety of monsters to test your PVE skills.

pages.title: New Hostile Mobs
pages.text: Know your enemies — each has unique abilities, drops, and weaknesses. For example, using $(item)Silver weapons$() against undead grants bonus damage and regeneration. Using $(item)Hammer weapons$() against skeletons deals 1.5x damage, and both bonuses can stack multiplicatively.

pages.name: Longdead (Ancient Skeleton)
pages.text: $(bold)Drop:$() $(item)Ancient Metal Chainmail Armor$() — the primary source of Ancient Metal.$(note)Spawns only in the Underworld.

pages.title: Longdead (Ancient Skeleton)
pages.text: Randomly spawns in two different types: ranged and melee.$(br2)The ranged type holds a bow and will try to keep its distance from the player.$(br2)The melee type holds an iron short sword and will actively approach the player.

pages.name: Bone Lord
pages.text: A more powerful skeleton variant. More dangerous than regular Longdead.$(note)Spawns only in the Underworld.

pages.title: Bone Lord
pages.text: When the player is far away, it will attack with a bow. Once the player approaches, it switches to a melee weapon.$(br2)When holding a Mithril Sword, it has an extremely long attack range and high damage. When holding a Mithril Hammer, it can stun the player, inflicting Slowness.$(br2)Upon detecting the player, it summons four enhanced Longdead to assist in combat.

pages.title: Zombie Variants
pages.text: $(li2)$(item)Wight$() — A white undead creature whose attacks drain the player's XP.$(li2)$(item)Ghoul$() — A standard ghoul enemy whose attacks inflict Slowness.$(li2)$(item)Shadow$() — A black ghoul that destroys nearby torches along its path.$(li2)$(item)Invisible Stalker$() — Nearly silent and invisible, inflicting Blindness on attack.$(li2)$(item)Revenant$() — A zombie variant with powerful attacks.$(br2)

pages.name: Pudding (Black Slime)
pages.text: A highly corrosive creature that rapidly corrodes your iron armor and weapons.$(note)Spawns only in the Underworld.

pages.name: Wood Spider
pages.text: Spawns rarely near trees. Its attacks inflict Poison.

pages.title: Elementals
pages.text: Four elemental golems guard their respective domains, requiring pickaxes and war hammers to deal damage.$(br)$(li2)$(item)Cobblestone Elemental$() — Found in cobblestone-rich areas$(li2)$(item)End Stone Elemental$() — Guards the End$(li2)$(item)Netherrack Elemental$() — Roams the Nether wastes$(li2)$(item)Obsidian Elemental$() — The toughest elemental, requires at least an Iron Pickaxe or War Hammer to attack

pages.title: Enderman
pages.text: $(bold)Caution$(): Besides not looking into its eyes, do not approach it while holding an Ender Pearl.$(br2)If you die too many times, Endermen will become permanently hostile, making the End extremely dangerous.$(br)$(note)When the Universal Aggro gamerule is enabled, Endermen will also be permanently hostile.

pages.title: Prepare for Battle
pages.text: Learn about weapons and armor to face these threats.
